messages.text: What evidence is required to compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a competitor for Wireless Communication without making unsupported claims?

### Short answer
To compare an R&S signaling / non-signaling Wireless Communication tester solution with a competitor without unsupported claims, use R&S formal specifications/features documents for R&S capabilities, competitor official documents or third-party evidence for competitor capabilities, and avoid treating sales battle cards or “Only R&S / lower TCO / future-proof” language as binding technical facts [2][6][25][28][29].
### Required evidence checklist
| Claim type | Evidence required | Why |
|---|---|---|
| R&S signaling capability, such as CMX500 LTE / NR / WLAN signaling | Cite CMX500 formal specifications and CMX500 Features and Functions, including document version, software scope, option codes, and limitations [10][37][39][73][74] | CMX500 formal sources define supported technologies, options, and the distinction between specifications and feature overview [10][73] |
| R&S non-signaling / production capability, such as CMP180, CMP200, or CMW100 K06 | Cite each product’s own specifications/features document, not a competitor battle card [18][20][21][23][24] | CMP180, CMP200, and CMW100 K06 have separate product scopes, specifications, calibration conditions, and option sets [18][20][23] |
| Binding technical numbers such as frequency range, bandwidth, data rate, uncertainty, or RF performance | Use specifications with limits and include test conditions, calibration interval, environmental conditions, warm-up, options, and whether the value is typical, nominal, measured, or warranted [22][49][73][87] | Data without tolerance limits is not binding, and typical / nominal / measured values are not guaranteed product performance [22][49][73][87] |
| Competitor capability or limitation | Cite competitor official documentation or independent third-party evidence; do not rely only on R&S internal battle cards [2][6][7][35][56] | R&S battle-card claims about amarisoft and Anritsu are sales positioning and lack competitor official confirmation in the cited pages [2][6][7][35][56] |
| Side-by-side competitor comparison | Use evidence that directly supports both sides of the comparison, or clearly separate R&S facts from competitor facts and label any connection as inference [4][26][62][64] | Existing comparison tables are battle-card positioning and include explicit source limitations for R&S and competitor claims [4][26][62][64] |
| Claims about “only platform,” “industry-leading,” “future-proof,” “lower TCO,” “fewer boxes,” or similar sales language | Provide formal evidence, calculation, dataset, or customer-use evidence; otherwise do not state the claim as fact [2][6][29][65] | These phrases are identified as sales language, and lower TCO / fewer boxes claims lack supporting calculations or formal evidence [2][6][29][65] |
| FR3 / RFU18 / future 6G-readiness claims | Use formal RFU18 / CMX500 specifications, order number, release data, supported configurations, bandwidth, software release, and measurement conditions before making technical comparison claims [29][58][59][60] | Current FR3 / RFU18 evidence is battle-card or PR/demo level and lacks formal RFU18 datasheet, order number, bandwidth, throughput, software release, and measurement conditions [58][59][60] |
| PTCRB / GCF / conformance / operator acceptance claims | Provide validation reports, approved test-case lists, TPAC/GCF/PTCRB database evidence, accreditation evidence, and the relevant versions or dates [44][46][48][62] | Existing sources mention competitor status or aligned tests but also note missing datasets, test case IDs, band combinations, or official validation evidence [44][46][48][62] |
| NTN, RedCap, Wi-Fi, fading, IP throughput, application testing, or automation comparisons | Cite R&S option/feature documents for R&S support and competitor official sources for competitor support; include option codes, software release, test setup, and measurement conditions where applicable [37][39][72][76] | R&S CMX500 feature sources list the relevant technologies, application tests, and interfaces, but feature overviews are not binding specifications [37][39][72][73][76] |
| Production-path comparison from signaling validation to factory non-signaling test | Cite CMX500 sources for signaling, and separately cite CMP180 / CMP200 / CMW100 K06 sources for production or non-signaling roles [10][16][19][21][24] | The production-path claim spans multiple R&S products, so each product role must be supported by its own product evidence [10][16][19][21][24] |
### Minimum evidence package before publishing a customer-facing comparison
1. R&S product evidence: CMX500 specifications Version 11.00 and CMX500 Features and Functions Version 32 for signaling, application, WLAN, fading, throughput, automation, and option-code claims [10][37][39][72][73][74][76].  
2. R&S non-signaling evidence: CMP180 Specifications / Features, CMP200 Specifications / Features, and CMW100 K06 specifications for production or non-signaling tester claims [18][20][21][23][24].  
4. Measurement evidence: test setup, DUT, band combination, carrier count, SCS, modulation, MIMO layers, software release, calibration state, environmental conditions, and tolerance or uncertainty basis for any performance number [22][41][59][60][73].  
5. Validation evidence: official validation reports, test case IDs, PTCRB / GCF / TPAC evidence, dates, and applicable work item or band-combination scope for conformance or operator-acceptance claims [44][46][48][62].  
6. Commercial or operational evidence: documented TCO calculation, box-count assumptions, license list, calibration/service assumptions, and workflow evidence before claiming lower TCO, fewer calibrations, or higher throughput [29][65].

2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card › 實體
- [[R&S CMX500]] — 來源主角；被定位為 integrated platform for signaling、validated testing、FR1、FR2 up to 50 GHz 與 Wi-Fi signaling。
- [[amarisoft]] — 競品；來源稱其為 small French private company，提供 software-based 4G/5G network stacks and test systems。

- [[UE Simbox Series]] — [[amarisoft]] product line。

Anritsu
[[Anritsu]] 是一間日本 test & measurement vendor；在 [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中被描述為 R&S radio communication tester portfolio 的競品供應商。

- Headquarters：Kanagawa, Japan。
- Company size：約 4,000+ employees global。
- Market positioning：source 稱其在 Japan T&M market share 為 #1，但 global footprint 較弱。
- Strengths：good LTE/eCall signaling（[[Anritsu MD8475B]]）、solid RF heritage、strong Japanese operator relationships。

FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張 › 來源主張
- 來源說 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] successfully validated high-throughput performance of a [[5G NR]] connection at **13 GHz**。
- 來源明示 proposed [[FR3]] frequency range 為 **7.125 GHz to 24.25 GHz**。
- 來源說 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] 的 5G mobile test platform（MTP）使用 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] in a maximum throughput use case at 13 GHz。
- 來源稱該 achievement confirms the potential of [[FR3]] to deliver high data rates using high [[MCS]]，並透過 [[4x4 MIMO]] enhanced capacity。
- 來源未提到 [[RFU18]]，也未提供 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 的 13 GHz hardware / software configuration。

依 [[Rohde & Schwarz demonstrates FR1–FR3 carrier aggregation, advancing 6G readiness]]（來源未標示 published date；raw created 2026-09-11；demo 日期 March 2 to 5, 2026）：

- 來源說 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] successfully demonstrated carrier aggregation across [[FR1]] and [[FR3]] frequency ranges。
- Demo 聚合約 **2.5 GHz** [[FR1]] channel 與約 **7 GHz** [[FR3]] channel，兩 band 均使用 [[4x4 MIMO]] 與 higher-order modulation。
- Test setup 核心是 [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester，extended with new [[RFU18]] board to provide coverage up to **18 GHz**。
- 來源稱 [[RFU18]] is a modular hardware upgrade for the [[R&S CMX500]] platform，讓 existing testers extend towards [[6G]]。
- 來源稱 all existing [[R&S CMX500]] platforms can be enhanced with new [[RFU18]] board to extend frequency coverage and capabilities without replacing the entire system。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] engineered for data rates up to **20 Gbps**，supporting wide dynamic range、[[4096QAM]] 與 up to **16 device antenna ports**。
- 來源仍未提供 [[RFU18]] order number、formal specs 文件編號、bandwidth、throughput、MCS index、software release 或 measurement conditions。

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › Sales landmines
[[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]] 建議用以下問題區分需求：

1. 是否需要 calibrated [[FR2]] / [[mmWave]] testing？
2. 是否需要 global support、multi-year warranty 或 calibration services？
3. 是否需要 [[Operator Acceptance]]、[[Conformance Testing]] 或 pre-conformance？
4. 是否需要 validated / [[PTCRB]] / [[GCF]] aligned test cases，而不只是 functional simulation？
5. 是否需要 non-signaling ATE 或 multi-port production test？
6. 是否需要 integrated [[Wi-Fi signaling]]（6/6E/7）？
7. 是否需要 factory line 的 non-signaling test capability？
8. 是否需要 3GPP RF pre-conformance 或 aligned test coverage？

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › 對比表
| 主題 | R&S / CMX500 positioning | amarisoft positioning | 來源限制 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 公司與支援 | Global support、field engineering、calibration labs、service contracts、multi-year warranties | small French private company；remote-only support；no global footprint | [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]] 未引用第三方或 amarisoft 官方文件 |
| FR1 / FR2 | [[R&S CMX500]] covers FR1、FR2 up to 50 GHz / calibrated FR2 | external RRH for FR2，calibration 以問號標示 | “up to 50 GHz” 為 battle card 說法；正式規格需引用 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] |
| Wi-Fi signaling | [[R&S CMX500]] integrated Wi-Fi signaling，含 Wi-Fi 6/6E/7 | external AP/N3IWF 或 no Wi-Fi signaling | Wi-Fi feature 需回查 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] |
| Conformance / operator acceptance | PTCRB/GCF aligned RF、RRM、protocol、IMS、VoNR、throughput、CA、mobility tests | functional only；not accepted for operator certification | 來源未列 test package option code 或 accreditation 文件 |
| Validated NTN | validated NR-NTN RF / RRM / protocol testcases，來源括註 w/ Samsung | functional simulation only | 未列 Samsung validation report 或 test case list |
| Legacy RAT | [[R&S CMW500]] 支援 2G/3G continuity | no 2G/3G stack | CMW500 正式能力需引用 [[CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700]] |
| Production path | [[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]] production / ATE / non-signaling path | no non-signaling platform、no production scaling path | 各 production platform 規格需分別引用其正式 source pages |
| Load / flexibility | battle card 主張 R&S validated testing | excellent functional load testing、up to 1000 UEs、flexible for NB-IoT / LTE-M / RedCap / basic NTN | amarisoft 能力缺少版本與硬體條件 |

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › R&S offensive plays
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]]：

- **One-Box FR1 + FR2 + Wi-Fi Signaling + Validated Testing**：將 [[R&S CMX500]] 定位為 integrated platform。
- **Migration Kit**：script conversion、Python / [[XLAPI]] mapping、on-site bring-up、trade-in program；來源未列交付細節或商務條件。
- **NTN & RedCap Acceleration**：強化 validated vs. simulated message。
- **O-RAN Upgrade Path**：R&S + [[VIAVI]] → ORU conformance / NES；來源未展開產品與規格。
- **Production Path (ATE)**：將 CMX validation scale 到 [[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]] production lines。

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › 對比表
| 主題 | R&S / CMX500 positioning | Anritsu positioning | 來源限制 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Legacy RF | [[R&S CMW500]] for 2G/3G continuity | [[Anritsu MT8821C]] needed even for most LTE cases | Anritsu LTE RF statement 未有官方文件佐證 |
| Production path | [[R&S CMP180]] / [[R&S CMP200]] / [[R&S CMW100 K06]] | MT8000A + MD8475B + MT8821C + MT8870A + MT8862A separate ecosystems；另 [[mx844030pc-j1200]] 補出 [[Anritsu MX844030PC]] 與 [[Anritsu MD8190A]] / [[MX819020A]] 的 virtual signalling path | source 未展開 MT8870A，也未提供完整 Anritsu production flow 文件 |

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › R&S offensive plays
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]]：

- **One-Box FR1 + FR2 + FR3 + WLAN + Fading + IP**：將 [[R&S CMX500]] 定位為 unified system，對比 Anritsu 的 MT8000A、MT8862A、IP Option 012 + external PC、external fading chambers 與 separate RF boards。
- **FR2 / FR3 performance leadership**：主張 R&S up to 50 GHz FR2、>16 GHz instantaneous bandwidth、>10 Gbps data rates 與 FR3 via RFU18；使用時需加註非正式規格限制。
- **Integrated WLAN signaling**：主張 R&S Wi-Fi 6 / 6E / 7 signaling directly inside CMX500，Anritsu 需 separate MT8862A。
- **R&D → Conformance → Production**：CMX500、CMW500、CMP180、CMP200、CMW100 構成 one vendor / one workflow / full lifecycle。
- **Future-proof technology**：Validated NTN、ORAN ORU / Conformance with partners、FR3 beyond 16 GHz、RedCap Rel-17/18。
- **Unified software ecosystem**：R&S Test Automation Suite 與 unified user experience；對比 Anritsu SSNR、RTD、ATS、MX844030PC。此項與 [[mx844030pc-j1200]] 對 MX844030PC common RTD GUI 的說明並列保留，使用時需標明來源層次。
- **Fewer Boxes. More Capability.**：以 fewer calibrations、fewer licenses、lower TCO、higher test throughput 作為 sales message；來源未提供 TCO 算式。

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › Sales landmines
[[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]] 建議用以下問題區分需求：

1. 是否需要 FR1 bandwidth beyond 400 MHz，例如 600–800 MHz per carrier for 5G-Advanced Rel-18 / Rel-19 testing？
2. 是否需要 FR1、FR2、FR3、WLAN 與 LTE 在 single instrument 中且不用 hardware swaps？
3. 是否需要 native fading with high-throughput IP testing？
4. 是否偏好 one unified software platform，而不是 four separate tools？
5. 是否需要 advanced CA 或 mobility without adding extra boxes？
6. 是否需要 FR3 testing beyond 16 GHz，以支援 emerging 6G FR3 evaluations？

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › 與 Anritsu MX844030PC 官方 brochure 的關係
[[mx844030pc-j1200]]（2026-02-10）是 Anritsu 對 [[Anritsu MX844030PC]] 的 product brochure，確認 MX844030PC 為 **Virtual Signalling Tester NR Software**，支援 MAC-IF、PHY-IF Digital-IQ 與 RF-IF for RedCap，並使用 common [[RTD]] GUI 連接 Pre-silicon / Post-silicon protocol testing workflow。

⚠️ 來源 [[mx844030pc-j1200]]（2026-02-10）說 [[Anritsu MX844030PC]] 使用 common [[RTD]] GUI，讓 NR protocol test cases 可在 Post-Silicon 與 Pre-silicon phase 間移植，但既有頁面 [[R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu]] 說 Anritsu software 為 SSNR + RTD + ATS + MX844030PC 的 fragmented / disconnected tools。判斷：官方 brochure 支撐 MX844030PC 與 RTD 有整合面；battle card 的 fragmented 判斷仍可作為 R&S sales positioning，但不得當作 Anritsu 官方規格描述。

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › 核心 thesis
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26），R&S 對 Anritsu 的核心定位是：[[R&S CMX500]] 提供 single integrated platform，涵蓋 FR1、FR2、FR3、fading、IP throughput、NTN、Wi-Fi、RF analysis 與 signaling；相對地，[[Anritsu MT8000A]] 被描述為需要多 RF boards、external mmWave converters、multiple boxes、external PC / tools 與 fragmented software ecosystem。

amarisoft › 來源中的競品定位
[[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]] 將 [[amarisoft]] 定位為 cost-efficient and flexible for functional testing，但列出以下限制：

- 缺少 calibrated RF。
- 缺少 conformance / operator acceptance assurance。
- 缺少 validated NTN。
- 缺少 global support、calibration labs、field service、SLAs。
- 缺少 instrument-class long warranty。
- FR2 依賴 external hardware / external RRH，來源以 “calibration?” 標示疑問。
- 缺少 2G/3G stack。
- 缺少 Wi-Fi signaling。
- 缺少 production / ATE testers 與 non-signaling factory-line path。

### Short answer
To compare an R&S signaling / non-signaling Wireless Communication tester solution with a competitor without unsupported claims, use R&S formal specifications/features documents for R&S capabilities, competitor official documents or third-party evidence for competitor capabilities, and avoid treating sales battle cards or “Only R&S / lower TCO / future-proof” language as binding technical facts [2][6][25][28][29].
### Required evidence checklist
| Claim type | Evidence required | Why |
|---|---|---|
| R&S signaling capability, such as CMX500 LTE / NR / WLAN signaling | Cite CMX500 formal specifications and CMX500 Features and Functions, including document version, software scope, option codes, and limitations [10][37][39][73][74] | CMX500 formal sources define supported technologies, options, and the distinction between specifications and feature overview [10][73] |
| R&S non-signaling / production capability, such as CMP180, CMP200, or CMW100 K06 | Cite each product’s own specifications/features document, not a competitor battle card [18][20][21][23][24] | CMP180, CMP200, and CMW100 K06 have separate product scopes, specifications, calibration conditions, and option sets [18][20][23] |
| Binding technical numbers such as frequency range, bandwidth, data rate, uncertainty, or RF performance | Use specifications with limits and include test conditions, calibration interval, environmental conditions, warm-up, options, and whether the value is typical, nominal, measured, or warranted [22][49][73][87] | Data without tolerance limits is not binding, and typical / nominal / measured values are not guaranteed product performance [22][49][73][87] |
| Competitor capability or limitation | Cite competitor official documentation or independent third-party evidence; do not rely only on R&S internal battle cards [2][6][7][35][56] | R&S battle-card claims about amarisoft and Anritsu are sales positioning and lack competitor official confirmation in the cited pages [2][6][7][35][56] |
| Side-by-side competitor comparison | Use evidence that directly supports both sides of the comparison, or clearly separate R&S facts from competitor facts and label any connection as inference [4][26][62][64] | Existing comparison tables are battle-card positioning and include explicit source limitations for R&S and competitor claims [4][26][62][64] |
| Claims about “only platform,” “industry-leading,” “future-proof,” “lower TCO,” “fewer boxes,” or similar sales language | Provide formal evidence, calculation, dataset, or customer-use evidence; otherwise do not state the claim as fact [2][6][29][65] | These phrases are identified as sales language, and lower TCO / fewer boxes claims lack supporting calculations or formal evidence [2][6][29][65] |
| FR3 / RFU18 / future 6G-readiness claims | Use formal RFU18 / CMX500 specifications, order number, release data, supported configurations, bandwidth, software release, and measurement conditions before making technical comparison claims [29][58][59][60] | Current FR3 / RFU18 evidence is battle-card or PR/demo level and lacks formal RFU18 datasheet, order number, bandwidth, throughput, software release, and measurement conditions [58][59][60] |
| PTCRB / GCF / conformance / operator acceptance claims | Provide validation reports, approved test-case lists, TPAC/GCF/PTCRB database evidence, accreditation evidence, and the relevant versions or dates [44][46][48][62] | Existing sources mention competitor status or aligned tests but also note missing datasets, test case IDs, band combinations, or official validation evidence [44][46][48][62] |
| NTN, RedCap, Wi-Fi, fading, IP throughput, application testing, or automation comparisons | Cite R&S option/feature documents for R&S support and competitor official sources for competitor support; include option codes, software release, test setup, and measurement conditions where applicable [37][39][72][76] | R&S CMX500 feature sources list the relevant technologies, application tests, and interfaces, but feature overviews are not binding specifications [37][39][72][73][76] |

- Non-traceable specifications with limits 標示為 n. trc.，因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，產品性能不保證。

- Typical data 標示為 typ.，若標示為 `<`、`>` 或 range，代表生產時約 80% instruments 可達到的 performance；否則代表 mean value。
- Nominal values 標示為 nom.，不進行 statistical evaluation，生產時不測試該參數。
- Measured values 標示為 meas.，以個別 samples 的 measurement results 描述 expected product performance。
- Uncertainties 以 coverage factor 2 定義，依 GUM 規則計算，納入 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。

CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700 › 規格條件與可信度限制
- 未標示 tolerance limits 的資料不具 binding 效力。
- 規格以 24-month calibration interval 為基準，除非另有說明。
- 指定規格需符合至少 15 minutes warm-up time、指定 environmental conditions、calibration cycle 已遵守，且所有 internal automatic adjustments 已執行。
- `typ.` 代表 typical values，在 final test 中驗證，但 Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- Nominal values 是 design parameters，產品開發期間驗證，但 production 期間不特別測試，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- 每台儀器在生產流程中依 defined procedures 校正；放行條件包含所有 measurement results 與 calibration system measurement uncertainties 必須落在 published specification limits 內。
- Calibration system expanded measurement uncertainties 以 coverage factor k = 2 決定，通常約 95 % probability。
- 斜體參數可直接在 tester 上設定。
